data.name: Hazwan
data.gender_notes: Hazwan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'hazan', meaning 'gift' or 'blessing'. It reflects the idea of receiving a valuable gift or being blessed with a special ability. This name is often given to a child who is considered a precious gift or blessing. The name Hazwan carries the meaning “Gift, blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hazwan usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Refers to the belief that every child is a gift from God, and this name serves as a constant reminder of that divine blessing.
data.etymology: Hazwan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, blessing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hazwan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: حزوان

in_arabic.long_meaning: حزوان هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه السعيد أو المفرح، وقد ورد في بعض المصادر أنه مشتق من الفعل حَزِنَ الذي يعني الفرح والسرور، وقد تسمى به المسلمون رجاءً للسعادة والفرح في الحياة

in_urdu.name: حزوان

in_pashto.name: حزوان
